body:
Shared source admission is implemented in draft PR #832. Presto [canonical-source report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/3ab625edce9ceb6aed9d94ee104306dcf84e248c/experiments/2026-10-25_0021_codex_intact-canonical/README.md) independently verifies every original XML cell/quantity, 17,862 input masses, 8,138 assignment/context joins and all 3,427 publisher links. The one quantity conflict, nine repeated views and missing IDs remain explicit.

A prospectively specified support census retains 1,278 F2 cells/237 sequences. Intact substrate is available in all 21 kinetic acquisitions; 80 sequences have at least two early times and one late time. These are candidate/support counts, not predictive results. [Next model specification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/3ab625edce9ceb6aed9d94ee104306dcf84e248c/experiments/agents/codex/plans/intact-kinetic-forecast.md) defines a future product/substrate-ratio forecast with direct controls, exact mass-conserving span expectations and explicitly hybrid conditional trajectory-score gradients.

45 focused source/query tests and 27 additional catalog-regression tests pass locally. Initial hosted CI found six stale global-version assertions; those were fixed without changing runtime/source bytes, and fresh full gates are required. No kinetic recipe or fit exists yet. Keep this issue open for numeric machinery data, physical replicate/material identity, unknown MS scaling and subsequent recipe qualification; source ingestion does not resolve those gaps.
next: shared kinetic recipe then registered forecast experiment
